note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. Times are fictional labels. No winner is shown.

presets.name: long-labels-stress
presets.description: Long names, roles, references, title, terms, withdrawal text, scenario labels and captions, time labels, changed fact, shared facts, guide and neutral labels; four events in A, three stations in B. Standing coordinator rule item 20 (caps with the true reason). The pre-cap values are kept in LAW-0451.presets.precap.json. At 1:1 the only arrangement that keeps the four people at the hold is the stages stacked in a left column with the comparison table and the notes in a right-hand column, and the table and the notes must share that column's height. Each capped field was restored alone to its pre-cap value on top of the shipped preset and rendered (1:1): A's withdrawal-sent time 32 -> 39 characters (and B's, the same event): 17 px, but no people at the hold (the stages fade at the guide; 0 of 4 visible). A's receipt times 30 -> 40 each: 17 px, no people at the hold. First shared fact 43 -> 58: no layout at 1:1. Shared facts 2 -> 4 (the third restored): no layout at 1:1. Neutral note 39 -> 113: no layout at 1:1. With the caps: 1:1 16.1 px, four people at the hold at 50.8 px (rendered); 16:9 18 px / 60.0 px; 9:16 21 px / 56.5 px. All other fields (both references, title, terms, withdrawal text, B's receipt times, captions, changed fact) keep their pre-cap length. Every capped field stays longer than baseline, and every count is at or above baseline (baseline has one shared fact).
